title: LoRA as Oracle
abstract: arXiv:2601.11207v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Practitioners increasingly deploy neural networks they did not train, and must audit them after the fact for hidden backdoors, without the training pipeline, the poisoned data, or knowledge of any trigger. We introduce a low-rank auditing lens built on a single observation: what a model has internalized and how it behaves are distinct axes that can diverge. Fitting a small low-rank adapter toward a hypothesis and reading the geometry of the resulting update, its energy relative to, and its alignment with, the frozen weights, measures internalization directly, independently of the model's output behavior. The lens earns its value where the two axes diverge: a backdoor is malicious internalization, a learned trigger-to-target shortcut, that behavioral auditing can miss. translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.11207v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：实践者越来越多地部署他们未训练的神经网络，并且必须在事后审计这些网络是否存在隐藏的后门，而无需训练流程、中毒数据或任何触发器的知识。我们引入了一个基于单一观察的低秩审计视角：模型内化的内容和其行为是可能分化的不同轴。通过拟合一个小的低秩适配器朝向某个假设，并解读所得更新的几何结构、其相对于冻结权重的能量及其对齐程度，可以直接测量内化程度，独立于模型的输出行为。该视角在两条轴分化时体现其价值：后门是恶意的内化，即学习到的触发器到目标的捷径，这可能是行为审计所遗漏的。通过解读它，我们在后门留下可辨识的内化特征时，无需标签或任何触发数据即可识别后门的目标类别，然后...
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于低秩适配器（LoRA）的审计方法，通过分析模型内部权重更新的几何特征来直接检测后门，无需训练数据或触发器，从而在行为审计失效时识别恶意内化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a low-rank adapter-based auditing lens that directly measures model internalization via weight update geometry, enabling label-free backdoor target detection without triggered data when behavioral auditing fails.
